additional_info.subject: Issue Description
additional_info.body:
TO BART BROECKX - HELIOX
In Brasschaat, we are also experiencing issues with the CCV
terminals. Wim visited the site to reinitialize the terminals and
adjust the TIDs. However, this was overlooked when we switched
from Siemens to Heliox.
Is it possible to include both Brasschaat and Auvelais in the
overview of terminals to be replaced?
At the time of the initial escalation, the chargers in question were
still under warranty
